name: Obadiah
author: Obadiah.
date: Probably after the fall of Jerusalem in 586 BC, though debated.
genre: Prophecy, the shortest book of the Old Testament.
theme: Pride falls, and the Lord’s kingdom will come.

outline.label: The vision and the call to war
As you did, it shall be done to you
Zion and the house of Jacob
The kingdom shall be the LORD’s

christInBook: The final verse, “the kingdom shall be the LORD’s,” points forward to the kingdom of Christ. Edom’s pride is set against the humility of the Messiah.
howToRead: Obadiah is one chapter and is best read in one sitting. Notice the theme of reversal: Edom’s pride is brought down, and Israel’s lowly remnant is lifted up.
